method.ruleSelection: Split css-rule selectors at top-level commas respecting parentheses and brackets; exclude each selector containing #coop-overlay.
method.comparison: Compare ordered normalized selector, declaration body and enclosing at-rule context tuples. Only whitespace is normalized; all declaration text, selector order and media ancestry remain part of comparison.
method.limitations: Static CSS isolation only; not a browser layout, cascade or physical-device qualification. Team selectors are deliberately outside this comparison.
